registered_getter_adapter.implementation: The library and native adapter share the singleton table and FetchWith algorithm. Native access retains PPC volatile widths and byte order; the adapter replays the 96-byte frame and live r3/r11/r12/r31, cr6 and LR operations. First-use constructor and registration calls use the existing guest function table and full PPCContext.
registered_getter_adapter.live_state: The global address is recomputed from live r31 after guest calls, registration runs even for a low-word null construction result and its final global is reloaded.
registered_getter_adapter.symbol_validation: The shared table matches the manifest. Generation checks other family maps and hand-written runtime symbols for collisions. The production linker map binds all 58 public getter symbols to semantic_registered_wrappers.cpp.obj, with the original fallback bodies retained in the PPC archive.

bounded_validation.scope: All getter symbols on the initialized branch, alternating actual direct and function-table wrapper calls; five first-use cases cover two owner constants, inline target, callback global mutation, low-word allocation failure and a callee-mutated r31. Full PPCContext, selected RAM/stack, nested SP/LR/full r3 events, table dispatch and fallback counts match the cached original getter bodies in both gate modes.
bounded_validation.lower_boundary: The bounded oracle uses deterministic guest constructor and registration stubs. The live runtime forwards to the existing guest table; no new native manager/constructor bridge is claimed.

build.scope: Incremental native runtime compile/link, using the existing PPC archive; the 19 field and 15 Property library entries also compiled and linked. A lookup-macro parentheses compilation error was corrected before the successful build and comparison. A later library-only incremental build compiled the marker and bounded metadata modules and linked the semantic library; those later entries have no runtime wrappers and were not included in the recorded scene binary.

scene_smoke.configuration: Windows D3D12, 1280x720, 30 FPS; AA/upscaling/HDR/frame generation off; one isolated writable save/profile copied from the previous scene seed; existing original scene observations reused.
scene_smoke.observed: Reached Map 20, Uhra - Residential Area. The scene capture shows the player, environment and HUD; one Y-button pulse opened the main menu. No crash or visible structural regression was observed.
scene_smoke.scope: A smoke run with the new gate enabled, without individual traces for all 58 getters. Later library-only initializer additions are outside this binary and scene scope.

evidence_reuse: Prior constructor/callback/getter library comparisons, runtime suites and baseline scenes were reused. No source/image hash pass, full PPC scan or regeneration, broad regression replay or performance measurement was added.
remaining_boundaries: Native constructor/manager service adapters and deeper vtable/CRT/kernel behavior remain pending.
The scene does not establish per-entry coverage, pixel identity, performance, combat, transitions, faults, MMIO, concurrency or cross-platform acceptance.
Original type layouts and complete semantic recovery of the game remain incomplete.
counting_note: 50 additional readable mapped entries (47 instance initializers plus three bounded metadata initializers); the three floating-point initializers retain a known signaling-NaN comparison gap. The 58 new runtime wrappers integrate already-mapped getters and add no recovered addresses. Mapped addresses are not counts of independent logical functions.

instance_field_initializer.validation: Three field-layout representatives with null/non-null full r3 and an unknown entry: seven checks passed; complete generated PPC bodies and parameters are statically matched.

instance_property_initializer.validation: Three vtable-immediate representatives with null/non-null full r3 and an unknown entry: seven checks passed; complete generated PPC bodies and the five ordered default-field writes are statically matched.

instance_marker_initializer.validation: Three vtable-immediate representatives with null/non-null full r3 and an unknown entry: seven checks passed, including the byte-width neighbor check; complete generated PPC bodies and parameters are statically matched.

registered_metadata_initializer.validation: Five bounded PPC comparisons plus an unknown entry check passed for finite values, minimum subnormal, negative zero and a write/source alias. All three complete instruction lists are checked. Caller-provided FPSCR flush-disable behavior remains an adapter boundary.

known_gap.scope: Signaling-NaN memory payload differs under clang-cl /O2 while observed FPR and FPSCR agree; /Od stores agree. This is an unresolved compiler-dependent original-C++ baseline discrepancy, not a passing semantic comparison. The entries remain incomplete and have no runtime wrapper.
